title: Wise and Foolish Builders
summary: Wisdom means hearing Jesus' words and putting them into practice. Wise and Foolish Builders gives kids a concrete picture of obedience instead of only a word to memorize. Jesus said hearing and doing His words is like building on rock.

read_it.prompt: Read Matthew 7:24-27. Look for what God does and how people respond.

tell_it: Jesus said hearing and doing His words is like building on rock. Jesus compared obedient listeners to a wise builder on rock. Hearing without obeying is like building on sand.
understand_it: Wise and Foolish Builders teaches through a concrete moment: a person chooses, God acts, and the result shows what matters. Wisdom means hearing Jesus' words and putting them into practice.
age_5_7_explanation: Jesus said hearing and doing His words is like building on rock.
age_8_11_explanation: Jesus compared obedient listeners to a wise builder on rock. Hearing without obeying is like building on sand. Kids can notice obedience in the choices people make, not only in the famous part of the story. Wisdom means hearing Jesus' words and putting them into practice.
teen_explanation: Wisdom means hearing Jesus' words and putting them into practice. When kids know the right answer but do not act on it, this parable says the foundation matters. Teens can also notice the tension in the passage: faith is not always easy, immediate, or admired by everyone nearby.
key_truths: Wisdom means hearing Jesus' words and putting them into practice.
Wise and Foolish Builders shows obedience through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When kids know the right answer but do not act on it, this parable says the foundation matters.
life_application: When kids know the right answer but do not act on it, this parable says the foundation matters.

quiz_questions.question: Which answer belongs to Wise and Foolish Builders?
choices: The wise man built on clouds
quiz_questions.explanation: On the rock is the correct answer. The detail matters because it keeps the lesson tied to Matthew 7:24-27, not just a general idea.

quiz_questions.question: Name the pressure, problem, or need in Wise and Foolish Builders.
quiz_questions.answer: Answers should name the story's real challenge and connect it to God's response.
quiz_questions.explanation: Good retelling notices what was hard before jumping straight to the takeaway.

memory_verse.prompt: Let Matthew 7:24 be the short line kids can carry after the activity is over.

discussion_questions: What happened first in Wise and Foolish Builders, and what changed by the end?
Where do you see obedience in Wise and Foolish Builders?
What is one small choice Wise and Foolish Builders could shape this week?

activity.title: Rock and Sand Test
activity.instructions: Build two small paper houses, one on rock and one on sand, then talk about obedience.

prayer_prompt: Father, help me see what Wise and Foolish Builders teaches and practice obedience in a real choice this week.
